WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), shares AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, execution_count,
         execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM grouped
), scored AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference
  FROM shares
)
SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, difference
FROM scored
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A NULL ordersmark is treated as one grouped order reference, as specified; its share is computed like any other group's share.
